## What problem does this solve?

Describe the situation or pain point. Who runs into it, and when?

## Proposed solution

What would make this better? A specific script, env var, doc addition, DNS-provider support, etc.

## Alternatives considered

Other ways to solve this that you thought about and rejected (and why).

## Scope check

Links, diagrams, example configs, upstream references.
